title: Price of Each Installment in Plan Arrears — Benefit Overpayment Accounts Schedule
content:
In the arrears payment on a defaulted Benefit Overpayment Accounts repayment plan, the price of each installment counted depends on how early the plan broke down, measured in whole months from the plan's first installment due date to the most recent returned installment (the booking date of the most recent return entry on the overpayment).

| Whole months from the first installment due date to the most recent returned installment | Price of each installment counted |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 6 (the early-breakdown months) | The classification's minimum monthly payment |
| At least 6 but fewer than 12 (the mid-breakdown months) | The midpoint of the plan's monthly installment and the classification's minimum monthly payment, that is, half of their sum |
| 12 or more, or no installment has been returned | The plan's monthly installment |

## Minimum monthly payment by classification

| Classification | Minimum monthly payment (USD) |
|---|---|
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Agency Error | 25.00 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Employer Reporting Error | 25.00 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Appeal Reversal | 25.00 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error | 25.00 |
| Fraud Overpayment — First Offense | 50.00 |
| Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense | 75.00 |

## Cases on a hypothetical Fraud Overpayment — First Offense plan with a monthly installment of USD 120.00

| Months to the most recent return | Price |
|---|---|
| 5 | USD 50.00 |
| 6 | USD 85.00, half of USD 120.00 plus USD 50.00 |
| 11 | USD 85.00 |
| 12 | USD 120.00 |
| No return on the ledger | USD 120.00 |
